title: Needs you
text: Anything that waits for your answer comes first: a request to approve, a suggestion to look at, something that went wrong. When nothing needs you, you can leave.

title: Live
text: Photos travelling between accounts show here as they move, both ways, and the counter climbs as they arrive.

title: Services
text: A service is a named place photos are handed to. Join one, or offer your own, here.

title: Offer a service
text: Give it a name and a tag, decide who may send, and share the invitation link or the QR code.

title: Send from this device
text: Choose photos on a phone or a computer and send them to a service without tagging them in Immich.

title: Settings
text: Rules, notifications, stories, the TV, pets and more, by category. Each card has a ? that opens its guide.

title: Ctrl K
text: Jump anywhere or do something from the keyboard: type a service, a view or a command.

title: Help
text: The ? opens the guides, with a search box. You can take this tour again from there, or from the card on the Overview.

title: Share this page
text: The address people use to join, with a QR code. Copy it into a message.

title: Check the connections
text: Tests every service's keys and says what is wrong and how to fix it.

title: Services and members
text: Every service as a row: who offers it, who sends, pauses and limits. Remove a member or a service that is stuck.

title: Backups
text: Download a backup of what the app keeps, and keep a copy of HANDOFF_STORE_KEY with it.

title: Pet helper
text: Shows whether the optional pet helper is on; the guide says how to switch it on.

title: Make it easy to find
text: A link and a hand-over button inside Immich itself: the guide shows how to add them.
